content:
**Four Leaf Clover** is a Luck-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

V.A.T.S. misses contribute to the critical meter based on Luck.

| ![FO76 four leaf clover perk bonus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/0/01/FO76_four_leaf_clover_perk_bonus.png) | | 
| | Luck | Fill Multiplier | 
| | 1 | +6% | 
| | 15 | +16% | 
| | 30 | +25% | 
| | 60 | +35% | 
| | 100 | +40% | 

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Misses in V.A.T.S. now contribute to the Critical Meter based on your LCK. | 0004D895 | 

- Before update 56 the perk provided 7.5%/10.5%/13.5% chance per hit to fill critical meter.
- With high enough Luck, it is possible to refill the Critical meter with every second shot regardless of a hit or miss; refer to this graph for an explanation. This graph is based on a player with 25 Luck, five Limit-Breaking legendary armor pieces, and rank 3 of Critical Savvy.

Vault Boy's outfit and fighting stance are a reference to the leprechaun mascot of the University of Notre Dame.
